title: Falcon Heavy Test Flight
tags: [none]
description: Following its first test launch, Falcon Heavy is now the most powerful operational rocket in the world by a factor of two. With the ability to lift into orbit nearly 64 metric tons (141,000 lb)---a mass greater than a 737 jetliner loaded with passengers, crew, luggage and fuel--Falcon Heavy can lift more than twice the payload of the next closest operational vehicle, the Delta IV Heavy, at one-third the cost. Falcon Heavy draws upon the proven heritage and reliability of Falcon 9. \n\nIts first stage is composed of three Falcon 9 nine-engine cores whose 27 Merlin engines together generate more than 5 million pounds of thrust at liftoff, equal to approximately eighteen 747 aircraft. Only the Saturn V moon rocket, last flown in 1973, delivered more payload to orbit. Falcon Heavy was designed from the outset to carry humans into space and restores the possibility of flying missions with crew to the Moon or Mars.

It’s been four years since theme park and luxury resort Jurassic World was destroyed by dinosaurs out of containment. Isla Nublar now sits abandoned by humans while the surviving dinosaurs fend for themselves in the jungles. 

When the island’s dormant volcano begins roaring to life, Owen (Chris Pratt) and Claire (Bryce Dallas Howard) mount a campaign to rescue the remaining dinosaurs from this extinction-level event. Owen is driven to find Blue, his lead raptor who’s still missing in the wild, and Claire has grown a respect for these creatures she now makes her mission. Arriving on the unstable island as lava begins raining down, their expedition uncovers a conspiracy that could return our entire planet to a perilous order not seen since prehistoric times.

With all of the wonder, adventure and thrills synonymous with one of the most popular and successful series in cinema history, this all-new motion-picture event sees the return of favorite characters and dinosaurs—along with new breeds more awe-inspiring and terrifying than ever before. Welcome to Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom.

They are joined by co-stars James Cromwell, Ted Levine, Justice Smith, Geraldine Chaplin, Daniella Pineda, Toby Jones, Rafe Spall and Isabella Sermon, while BD Wong and Jeff Goldblum reprise their roles. 

Directed by J.A. Bayona (The Impossible), the epic action-adventure is written by Jurassic World’s director, Trevorrow, and its co-writer, Derek Connolly. title: Falcon Heavy Test Flight
tags: [none]
description: Following its first test launch, Falcon Heavy is now the most powerful operational rocket in the world by a factor of two. With the ability to lift into orbit nearly 64 metric tons (141,000 lb)---a mass greater than a 737 jetliner loaded with passengers, crew, luggage and fuel--Falcon Heavy can lift more than twice the payload of the next closest operational vehicle, the Delta IV Heavy, at one-third the cost. Falcon Heavy draws upon the proven heritage and reliability of Falcon 9. \n\nIts first stage is composed of three Falcon 9 nine-engine cores whose 27 Merlin engines together generate more than 5 million pounds of thrust at liftoff, equal to approximately eighteen 747 aircraft. Only the Saturn V moon rocket, last flown in 1973, delivered more payload to orbit. Falcon Heavy was designed from the outset to carry humans into space and restores the possibility of flying missions with crew to the Moon or Mars.

It’s been four years since theme park and luxury resort Jurassic World was destroyed by dinosaurs out of containment. Isla Nublar now sits abandoned by humans while the surviving dinosaurs fend for themselves in the jungles. 

When the island’s dormant volcano begins roaring to life, Owen (Chris Pratt) and Claire (Bryce Dallas Howard) mount a campaign to rescue the remaining dinosaurs from this extinction-level event. Owen is driven to find Blue, his lead raptor who’s still missing in the wild, and Claire has grown a respect for these creatures she now makes her mission. Arriving on the unstable island as lava begins raining down, their expedition uncovers a conspiracy that could return our entire planet to a perilous order not seen since prehistoric times.

They are joined by co-stars James Cromwell, Ted Levine, Justice Smith, Geraldine Chaplin, Daniella Pineda, Toby Jones, Rafe Spall and Isabella Sermon, while BD Wong and Jeff Goldblum reprise their roles. 

Directed by J.A. Bayona (The Impossible), the epic action-adventure is written by Jurassic World’s director, Trevorrow, and its co-writer, Derek Connolly. title: Falcon Heavy Test Flight
tags: [none]
description: Following its first test launch, Falcon Heavy is now the most powerful operational rocket in the world by a factor of two. With the ability to lift into orbit nearly 64 metric tons (141,000 lb)---a mass greater than a 737 jetliner loaded with passengers, crew, luggage and fuel--Falcon Heavy can lift more than twice the payload of the next closest operational vehicle, the Delta IV Heavy, at one-third the cost. Falcon Heavy draws upon the proven heritage and reliability of Falcon 9. \n\nIts first stage is composed of three Falcon 9 nine-engine cores whose 27 Merlin engines together generate more than 5 million pounds of thrust at liftoff, equal to approximately eighteen 747 aircraft. Only the Saturn V moon rocket, last flown in 1973, delivered more payload to orbit. Falcon Heavy was designed from the outset to carry humans into space and restores the possibility of flying missions with crew to the Moon or Mars.

It’s been four years since theme park and luxury resort Jurassic World was destroyed by dinosaurs out of containment. Isla Nublar now sits abandoned by humans while the surviving dinosaurs fend for themselves in the jungles. 

When the island’s dormant volcano begins roaring to life, Owen (Chris Pratt) and Claire (Bryce Dallas Howard) mount a campaign to rescue the remaining dinosaurs from this extinction-level event. Owen is driven to find Blue, his lead raptor who’s still missing in the wild, and Claire has grown a respect for these creatures she now makes her mission. Arriving on the unstable island as lava begins raining down, their expedition uncovers a conspiracy that could return our entire planet to a perilous order not seen since prehistoric times.

With all of the wonder, adventure and thrills synonymous with one of the most popular and successful series in cinema history, this all-new motion-picture event sees the return of favorite characters and dinosaurs—along with new breeds more awe-inspiring and terrifying than ever before. Directed by J.A. Bayona (The Impossible), the epic action-adventure is written by Jurassic World’s director, Trevorrow, and its co-writer, Derek Connolly. title: Falcon Heavy Test Flight
tags: [none]
description: Following its first test launch, Falcon Heavy is now the most powerful operational rocket in the world by a factor of two. With the ability to lift into orbit nearly 64 metric tons (141,000 lb)---a mass greater than a 737 jetliner loaded with passengers, crew, luggage and fuel--Falcon Heavy can lift more than twice the payload of the next closest operational vehicle, the Delta IV Heavy, at one-third the cost. Falcon Heavy draws upon the proven heritage and reliability of Falcon 9. \n\nIts first stage is composed of three Falcon 9 nine-engine cores whose 27 Merlin engines together generate more than 5 million pounds of thrust at liftoff, equal to approximately eighteen 747 aircraft. Only the Saturn V moon rocket, last flown in 1973, delivered more payload to orbit. Falcon Heavy was designed from the outset to carry humans into space and restores the possibility of flying missions with crew to the Moon or Mars.

Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom

https://www.jurassicworld.com 

It’s been four years since theme park and luxury resort Jurassic World was destroyed by dinosaurs out of containment. Isla Nublar now sits abandoned by humans while the surviving dinosaurs fend for themselves in the jungles. 

When the island’s dormant volcano begins roaring to life, Owen (Chris Pratt) and Claire (Bryce Dallas Howard) mount a campaign to rescue the remaining dinosaurs from this extinction-level event. Owen is driven to find Blue, his lead raptor who’s still missing in the wild, and Claire has grown a respect for these creatures she now makes her mission. Arriving on the unstable island as lava begins raining down, their expedition uncovers a conspiracy that could return our entire planet to a perilous order not seen since prehistoric times.

With all of the wonder, adventure and thrills synonymous with one of the most popular and successful series in cinema history, this all-new motion-picture event sees the return of favorite characters and dinosaurs—along with new breeds more awe-inspiring and terrifying than ever before. Welcome to Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom. 

Stars Pratt and Howard return alongside executive producers Steven Spielberg and Colin Trevorrow for Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom. They are joined by co-stars James Cromwell, Ted Levine, Justice Smith, Geraldine Chaplin, Daniella Pineda, Toby Jones, Rafe Spall and Isabella Sermon, while BD Wong and Jeff Goldblum reprise their roles. 

Directed by J.A. Bayona (The Impossible), the epic action-adventure is written by Jurassic World’s director, Trevorrow, and its co-writer, Derek Connolly. title: Falcon Heavy Test Flight
tags: [none]
description: Following its first test launch, Falcon Heavy is now the most powerful operational rocket in the world by a factor of two. With the ability to lift into orbit nearly 64 metric tons (141,000 lb)---a mass greater than a 737 jetliner loaded with passengers, crew, luggage and fuel--Falcon Heavy can lift more than twice the payload of the next closest operational vehicle, the Delta IV Heavy, at one-third the cost. Falcon Heavy draws upon the proven heritage and reliability of Falcon 9. \n\nIts first stage is composed of three Falcon 9 nine-engine cores whose 27 Merlin engines together generate more than 5 million pounds of thrust at liftoff, equal to approximately eighteen 747 aircraft. Only the Saturn V moon rocket, last flown in 1973, delivered more payload to orbit. description:
Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom 
In Theaters June 22, 2018 
Try the Jurassic World effect on your Facebook camera: http://unvrs.al/JWFBCam 

https://www.jurassicworld.com 

It’s been four years since theme park and luxury resort Jurassic World was destroyed by dinosaurs out of containment. Isla Nublar now sits abandoned by humans while the surviving dinosaurs fend for themselves in the jungles. 

When the island’s dormant volcano begins roaring to life, Owen (Chris Pratt) and Claire (Bryce Dallas Howard) mount a campaign to rescue the remaining dinosaurs from this extinction-level event. Owen is driven to find Blue, his lead raptor who’s still missing in the wild, and Claire has grown a respect for these creatures she now makes her mission. Arriving on the unstable island as lava begins raining down, their expedition uncovers a conspiracy that could return our entire planet to a perilous order not seen since prehistoric times.

With all of the wonder, adventure and thrills synonymous with one of the most popular and successful series in cinema history, this all-new motion-picture event sees the return of favorite characters and dinosaurs—along with new breeds more awe-inspiring and terrifying than ever before. Welcome to Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom. 

Stars Pratt and Howard return alongside executive producers Steven Spielberg and Colin Trevorrow for Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom. They are joined by co-stars James Cromwell, Ted Levine, Justice Smith, Geraldine Chaplin, Daniella Pineda, Toby Jones, Rafe Spall and Isabella Sermon, while BD Wong and Jeff Goldblum reprise their roles. 

Directed by J.A. Bayona (The Impossible), the epic action-adventure is written by Jurassic World’s director, Trevorrow, and its co-writer, Derek Connolly. Producers Frank Marshall and Pat Crowley once again partner with Spielberg and Trevorrow in leading the filmmakers for this stunning installment. Belén Atienza joins the team as a producer.

title: Falcon Heavy Test Flight
tags: [none]
description: Following its first test launch, Falcon Heavy is now the most powerful operational rocket in the world by a factor of two. With the ability to lift into orbit nearly 64 metric tons (141,000 lb)---a mass greater than a 737 jetliner loaded with passengers, crew, luggage and fuel--Falcon Heavy can lift more than twice the payload of the next closest operational vehicle, the Delta IV Heavy, at one-third the cost. Falcon Heavy draws upon the proven heritage and reliability of Falcon 9. \n\nIts first stage is composed of three Falcon 9 nine-engine cores whose 27 Merlin engines together generate more than 5 million pounds of thrust at liftoff, equal to approximately eighteen 747 aircraft. Only the Saturn V moon rocket, last flown in 1973, delivered more payload to orbit. Falcon Heavy was designed from the outset to carry humans into space and restores the possibility of flying missions with crew to the Moon or Mars.

It’s been four years since theme park and luxury resort Jurassic World was destroyed by dinosaurs out of containment. Isla Nublar now sits abandoned by humans while the surviving dinosaurs fend for themselves in the jungles. 

When the island’s dormant volcano begins roaring to life, Owen (Chris Pratt) and Claire (Bryce Dallas Howard) mount a campaign to rescue the remaining dinosaurs from this extinction-level event. Owen is driven to find Blue, his lead raptor who’s still missing in the wild, and Claire has grown a respect for these creatures she now makes her mission. Arriving on the unstable island as lava begins raining down, their expedition uncovers a conspiracy that could return our entire planet to a perilous order not seen since prehistoric times.

With all of the wonder, adventure and thrills synonymous with one of the most popular and successful series in cinema history, this all-new motion-picture event sees the return of favorite characters and dinosaurs—along with new breeds more awe-inspiring and terrifying than ever before. Welcome to Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom. 

Stars Pratt and Howard return alongside executive producers Steven Spielberg and Colin Trevorrow for Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom. They are joined by co-stars James Cromwell, Ted Levine, Justice Smith, Geraldine Chaplin, Daniella Pineda, Toby Jones, Rafe Spall and Isabella Sermon, while BD Wong and Jeff Goldblum reprise their roles. 

Directed by J.A. Bayona (The Impossible), the epic action-adventure is written by Jurassic World’s director, Trevorrow, and its co-writer, Derek Connolly. description: Following its first test launch, Falcon Heavy is now the most powerful operational rocket in the world by a factor of two. With the ability to lift into orbit nearly 64 metric tons (141,000 lb)---a mass greater than a 737 jetliner loaded with passengers, crew, luggage and fuel--Falcon Heavy can lift more than twice the payload of the next closest operational vehicle, the Delta IV Heavy, at one-third the cost. Falcon Heavy draws upon the proven heritage and reliability of Falcon 9. \n\nIts first stage is composed of three Falcon 9 nine-engine cores whose 27 Merlin engines together generate more than 5 million pounds of thrust at liftoff, equal to approximately eighteen 747 aircraft. Only the Saturn V moon rocket, last flown in 1973, delivered more payload to orbit. Falcon Heavy was designed from the outset to carry humans into space and restores the possibility of flying missions with crew to the Moon or Mars.

It’s been four years since theme park and luxury resort Jurassic World was destroyed by dinosaurs out of containment. Isla Nublar now sits abandoned by humans while the surviving dinosaurs fend for themselves in the jungles. 

When the island’s dormant volcano begins roaring to life, Owen (Chris Pratt) and Claire (Bryce Dallas Howard) mount a campaign to rescue the remaining dinosaurs from this extinction-level event. Owen is driven to find Blue, his lead raptor who’s still missing in the wild, and Claire has grown a respect for these creatures she now makes her mission. Arriving on the unstable island as lava begins raining down, their expedition uncovers a conspiracy that could return our entire planet to a perilous order not seen since prehistoric times.

Directed by J.A. Bayona (The Impossible), the epic action-adventure is written by Jurassic World’s director, Trevorrow, and its co-writer, Derek Connolly. title: Falcon Heavy Test Flight
tags: [none]
description: Following its first test launch, Falcon Heavy is now the most powerful operational rocket in the world by a factor of two. With the ability to lift into orbit nearly 64 metric tons (141,000 lb)---a mass greater than a 737 jetliner loaded with passengers, crew, luggage and fuel--Falcon Heavy can lift more than twice the payload of the next closest operational vehicle, the Delta IV Heavy, at one-third the cost. Falcon Heavy draws upon the proven heritage and reliability of Falcon 9. \n\nIts first stage is composed of three Falcon 9 nine-engine cores whose 27 Merlin engines together generate more than 5 million pounds of thrust at liftoff, equal to approximately eighteen 747 aircraft. Only the Saturn V moon rocket, last flown in 1973, delivered more payload to orbit. Falcon Heavy was designed from the outset to carry humans into space and restores the possibility of flying missions with crew to the Moon or Mars.

Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom 
In Theaters June 22, 2018

https://www.jurassicworld.com 

It’s been four years since theme park and luxury resort Jurassic World was destroyed by dinosaurs out of containment. Isla Nublar now sits abandoned by humans while the surviving dinosaurs fend for themselves in the jungles. 

When the island’s dormant volcano begins roaring to life, Owen (Chris Pratt) and Claire (Bryce Dallas Howard) mount a campaign to rescue the remaining dinosaurs from this extinction-level event. Owen is driven to find Blue, his lead raptor who’s still missing in the wild, and Claire has grown a respect for these creatures she now makes her mission. Arriving on the unstable island as lava begins raining down, their expedition uncovers a conspiracy that could return our entire planet to a perilous order not seen since prehistoric times.

With all of the wonder, adventure and thrills synonymous with one of the most popular and successful series in cinema history, this all-new motion-picture event sees the return of favorite characters and dinosaurs—along with new breeds more awe-inspiring and terrifying than ever before. Welcome to Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom. 

Stars Pratt and Howard return alongside executive producers Steven Spielberg and Colin Trevorrow for Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom. They are joined by co-stars James Cromwell, Ted Levine, Justice Smith, Geraldine Chaplin, Daniella Pineda, Toby Jones, Rafe Spall and Isabella Sermon, while BD Wong and Jeff Goldblum reprise their roles. 

Directed by J.A. Bayona (The Impossible), the epic action-adventure is written by Jurassic World’s director, Trevorrow, and its co-writer, Derek Connolly. Producers Frank Marshall and Pat Crowley once again partner with Spielberg and Trevorrow in leading the filmmakers for this stunning installment. Belén Atienza joins the team as a producer.

description: Following its first test launch, Falcon Heavy is now the most powerful operational rocket in the world by a factor of two. With the ability to lift into orbit nearly 64 metric tons (141,000 lb)---a mass greater than a 737 jetliner loaded with passengers, crew, luggage and fuel--Falcon Heavy can lift more than twice the payload of the next closest operational vehicle, the Delta IV Heavy, at one-third the cost. Falcon Heavy draws upon the proven heritage and reliability of Falcon 9. \n\nIts first stage is composed of three Falcon 9 nine-engine cores whose 27 Merlin engines together generate more than 5 million pounds of thrust at liftoff, equal to approximately eighteen 747 aircraft. Only the Saturn V moon rocket, last flown in 1973, delivered more payload to orbit. Falcon Heavy was designed from the outset to carry humans into space and restores the possibility of flying missions with crew to the Moon or Mars.

description:
Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom 
In Theaters June 22, 2018 
Try the Jurassic World effect on your Facebook camera: http://unvrs.al/JWFBCam 

https://www.jurassicworld.com 

It’s been four years since theme park and luxury resort Jurassic World was destroyed by dinosaurs out of containment. Isla Nublar now sits abandoned by humans while the surviving dinosaurs fend for themselves in the jungles. 

When the island’s dormant volcano begins roaring to life, Owen (Chris Pratt) and Claire (Bryce Dallas Howard) mount a campaign to rescue the remaining dinosaurs from this extinction-level event. Owen is driven to find Blue, his lead raptor who’s still missing in the wild, and Claire has grown a respect for these creatures she now makes her mission. Arriving on the unstable island as lava begins raining down, their expedition uncovers a conspiracy that could return our entire planet to a perilous order not seen since prehistoric times.

With all of the wonder, adventure and thrills synonymous with one of the most popular and successful series in cinema history, this all-new motion-picture event sees the return of favorite characters and dinosaurs—along with new breeds more awe-inspiring and terrifying than ever before. Welcome to Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom. 

Stars Pratt and Howard return alongside executive producers Steven Spielberg and Colin Trevorrow for Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom. They are joined by co-stars James Cromwell, Ted Levine, Justice Smith, Geraldine Chaplin, Daniella Pineda, Toby Jones, Rafe Spall and Isabella Sermon, while BD Wong and Jeff Goldblum reprise their roles. 

Directed by J.A. Bayona (The Impossible), the epic action-adventure is written by Jurassic World’s director, Trevorrow, and its co-writer, Derek Connolly. Producers Frank Marshall and Pat Crowley once again partner with Spielberg and Trevorrow in leading the filmmakers for this stunning installment. Belén Atienza joins the team as a producer.

description:
Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom
In Theaters June 22, 2018 

https://www.jurassicworld.com

It’s been four years since theme park and luxury resort Jurassic World was destroyed by dinosaurs out of containment.  Isla Nublar now sits abandoned by humans while the surviving dinosaurs fend for themselves in the jungles.

When the island’s dormant volcano begins roaring to life, Owen (Chris Pratt) and Claire (Bryce Dallas Howard) mount a campaign to rescue the remaining dinosaurs from this extinction-level event.  Owen is driven to find Blue, his lead raptor who’s still missing in the wild, and Claire has grown a respect for these creatures she now makes her mission.  Arriving on the unstable island as lava begins raining down, their expedition uncovers a conspiracy that could return our entire planet to a perilous order not seen since prehistoric times.

With all of the wonder, adventure and thrills synonymous with one of the most popular and successful series in cinema history, this all-new motion-picture event sees the return of favorite characters and dinosaurs—along with new breeds more awe-inspiring and terrifying than ever before.  Welcome to Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom.  

Stars Pratt and Howard return alongside executive producers Steven Spielberg and Colin Trevorrow for Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom.  They are joined by co-stars James Cromwell, Ted Levine, Justice Smith, Geraldine Chaplin, Daniella Pineda, Toby Jones, Rafe Spall and Isabella Sermon, while BD Wong and Jeff Goldblum reprise their roles.

Directed by J.A. Bayona (The Impossible), the epic action-adventure is written by Jurassic World’s director, Trevorrow, and its co-writer, Derek Connolly.  Producers Frank Marshall and Pat Crowley once again partner with Spielberg and Trevorrow in leading the filmmakers for this stunning installment.  Belén Atienza joins the team as a producer.

description:
Real Sociedad vs Barcelona 2-4 - All Goals & Extended Highlights - La Liga 14/01/2018 HD
Goals: Willian Jose 11', Juanmi 34', Paulinho 39', Luis Suarez 50', 71', Lionel Messi 85'

Spanish La Liga
Real Sociedad vs Barcelona
7:45pm Sunday 14th January
Anoeta  

Barcelona were 2-0 down against Real Sociedad before fighting back to claim the victory and break a long winless run at Anoeta.
Lionel Messi set a new goalscoring landmark as Barcelona came from two goals down to beat Real Sociedad 4-2 and break their Anoeta cruse.

A stunning late free-kick at the end of an otherwise quiet outing from the Argentina star made him the top league goalscorer for one club in any of Europe's top five divisions, surpassing Gerd Muller with his 366th LaLiga goal.

The Catalan giants had returned winless from their last seven trips to Sociedad in the top flight and were primed for further disappointment after falling behind to Willian Jose's 11th-minute header. 

Juanmi doubled the hosts' lead with a heavily deflected finish after a superb assist from Sergio Canales, but that only served to stir Barca into life and Paulinho reduced the deficit before half-time. 

Within five minutes of the restart the scores were level as Luis Suarez finished brilliantly for his 12th league goal of the season.

Suarez then grabbed a second 19 minutes from time after goalkeeper Geronimo Rulli's poor clearance proved costly for Eusebio Sacristan's men, with Messi putting the icing on the cake.

The result restores Barca's nine-point lead at the summit, elevating them 19 ahead of champions Real Madrid, breaking an 11-year spell without a league win at Anoeta in the process.

Barca – without the services of injured new signing Philippe Coutinho – started brightly and Suarez was denied by the onrushing Rulli at the end of a determined run into the Sociedad box, while the keeper also had to be alert to keep out Sergi Roberto soon after.

But the visitors found themselves behind as Willian Jose headed Xabi Prieto's searching cross into the ground and over Marc-Andre ter Stegen.

description:
Real Sociedad vs Barcelona 2-4 - All Goals & Extended Highlights - La Liga 14/01/2018 HD
Goals: Willian Jose 11', Juanmi 34', Paulinho 39', Luis Suarez 50', 71', Lionel Messi 85'

Spanish La Liga
Real Sociedad vs Barcelona
7:45pm Sunday 14th January
Anoeta  

Barcelona were 2-0 down against Real Sociedad before fighting back to claim the victory and break a long winless run at Anoeta.
Lionel Messi set a new goalscoring landmark as Barcelona came from two goals down to beat Real Sociedad 4-2 and break their Anoeta cruse.

A stunning late free-kick at the end of an otherwise quiet outing from the Argentina star made him the top league goalscorer for one club in any of Europe's top five divisions, surpassing Gerd Muller with his 366th LaLiga goal.

The Catalan giants had returned winless from their last seven trips to Sociedad in the top flight and were primed for further disappointment after falling behind to Willian Jose's 11th-minute header. 

Juanmi doubled the hosts' lead with a heavily deflected finish after a superb assist from Sergio Canales, but that only served to stir Barca into life and Paulinho reduced the deficit before half-time. 

Within five minutes of the restart the scores were level as Luis Suarez finished brilliantly for his 12th league goal of the season.

Suarez then grabbed a second 19 minutes from time after goalkeeper Geronimo Rulli's poor clearance proved costly for Eusebio Sacristan's men, with Messi putting the icing on the cake.

The result restores Barca's nine-point lead at the summit, elevating them 19 ahead of champions Real Madrid, breaking an 11-year spell without a league win at Anoeta in the process.

Barca – without the services of injured new signing Philippe Coutinho – started brightly and Suarez was denied by the onrushing Rulli at the end of a determined run into the Sociedad box, while the keeper also had to be alert to keep out Sergi Roberto soon after.

But the visitors found themselves behind as Willian Jose headed Xabi Prieto's searching cross into the ground and over Marc-Andre ter Stegen.

description:
Tholi Prema Theatrical Trailer on SVCC. #Tholiprema 2018 Latest Telugu Movie ft. Varun Tej, Raashi Khanna and Sapna Pabbi. Music by Thaman S. Directed by Venky Atluri & produced by BVSN Prasad under Sri Venkateswara Cine Chitra banner. #TholipremaTheatricalTrailer #TholipremaTrailer #VarunTej #RaashiKhanna #Raashi #SapnaPabbi #SuhasiniManiratnam #VenkyAtluri #Thaman #ThamanS #SVCC24 #VT6 #SVCC #SriVenkateswaraCineChitra

Varun Tej's Tholi prema movie also stars Suhasini Maniratnam, Priyadarshi, Vidyullekha Raman, Viva Harsha & among others. Successful Producer Dil Raju who has given super hits like Duvvada Jagannadham, Nenu Local, Fidaa, Shatamanam Bhavathi and MCA recently is releasing Tholiprema movie under his banner SVC Films.

Movie Details:
Cast: Varun Tej & Raashi Khanna
Music: Thaman S
Producer: BVSN Prasad
Director: Venky Atluri
DOP: George C. Williams
Banner: Sri Venkateswara Cine Chitra
Editor : Naveen Nooli

Varun Tej is the son of Naga Babu and the nephew of Tollywood Heroes Megastar Chiranjeevi and Power Star Pawan Kalyan. After making a grand debut with Mukunda, Varun Tej continued his successful journey with National Award winning movie Kanche, Puri Jagannadh's Loafer, Sreenu Vaitla's Mister. Varun Tej registered his career's biggest blockbuster Fidaa movie directed by Sekhar Kammula and produced by Dil Raju, who is now enjoying the success of Nani's MCA. Praja Rajyam Party founder Chiranjeevi is now busy with Sye Raa Narasimha Reddy, while Janasena Party founder came up with Trivikram's Agnyaathavaasi movie recently.

Raashi Khanna is on a super success with Jr NTR's highest grosser, 2017 movie Jai Lava Kusa co.ft. Nivetha Thomas. Along with Ravi Teja's TCC movie, the actress is also coming up with Ravi Teja's Touch Chesi Chudu co-featuring Seerat Kapoor. The movie is being directed by Vikram Sirikonda. Music by JAM8. Produced by Nallamalapu Srinivas (Bujji) and Vallabhaneni Vamsi under Lakshmi Narasimha Productions (LNP) banner.

Sapna Pabbi is a Model turned actress. She is known for her Kiran Rathod role in 24, an Indian TV series and She made her Bollywood debut with Hindi film Khamoshiyan.

Priyadarshi is the latest sensation in Tollywood. His comedy timing in Vijay Deverakonda's Pelli Choopulu will be remembered for a long time. His appearances in Jr NTR's Jai Lava Kusa, Rana Daggubati's Ghazi, Mahesh Babu's Spyder got good response. He is now coming up with Nani's AWE and Sundeep Kishan's Manasuku Nachindi.

Thaman S has been the music sensation in Tollywood, since his first movie Kick with Ravi Teja who is now coming up with Touch Chesi Choodu. Thaman had composed somany hit albums like Anushka's Bhaagamathie, Nagarjuna - Samantha's Raju Gari Gadhi 2, Sai Dharam Tej's Jawaan, Sharwanand's Mahanubhavudu and many other albums. Sai Dharan Tej's Intelligent is his upcoming movie.

Director Venky Atluri is an actor cum Director, who made his acting debut with Kerintha and directorial debut with It's My Love Story movie. He is well known for his dialogues. Tholi Prema will be a game changer for Venky Atluri in Tollywood.

BVSN Prasad is someone loved by everyone in Tollywood. The super hit movies produced by him on his banner Sri Venkateswara Cine Chitra / SVCC include Pawan Kalyan's Attarintiki Daredi, Jr NTR's Nannaku Prematho, Naga Chaitanya's Dochay, Prabhas Darling, Allu Arjun's Arya 2, Ravi Teja's Khatarnak,Sharwanand's Radha and others.

tags: Jurassic World|"Fallen Kingdom"|"Dinosaur"|"T-Rex"|"Chris Pratt"|"Bryce Dallas Howard"|"BD Wong"|"James Cromwell"|"Ted Levine"|"Justice Smith"|"Jeff Goldblum"|"Daniella Pineda"|"J.A. Bayona"|"Colin Trevorrow"|"Steven Spielberg"|"Isla Nublar"|"volcano"|"Jurassic Park"
description:
Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom 
In Theaters June 22, 2018 
Try the Jurassic World effect on your Facebook camera: http://unvrs.al/JWFBCam 

https://www.jurassicworld.com 

It’s been four years since theme park and luxury resort Jurassic World was destroyed by dinosaurs out of containment. Isla Nublar now sits abandoned by humans while the surviving dinosaurs fend for themselves in the jungles. 

When the island’s dormant volcano begins roaring to life, Owen (Chris Pratt) and Claire (Bryce Dallas Howard) mount a campaign to rescue the remaining dinosaurs from this extinction-level event. Owen is driven to find Blue, his lead raptor who’s still missing in the wild, and Claire has grown a respect for these creatures she now makes her mission. Arriving on the unstable island as lava begins raining down, their expedition uncovers a conspiracy that could return our entire planet to a perilous order not seen since prehistoric times.

With all of the wonder, adventure and thrills synonymous with one of the most popular and successful series in cinema history, this all-new motion-picture event sees the return of favorite characters and dinosaurs—along with new breeds more awe-inspiring and terrifying than ever before. Welcome to Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom. 

Stars Pratt and Howard return alongside executive producers Steven Spielberg and Colin Trevorrow for Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom. They are joined by co-stars James Cromwell, Ted Levine, Justice Smith, Geraldine Chaplin, Daniella Pineda, Toby Jones, Rafe Spall and Isabella Sermon, while BD Wong and Jeff Goldblum reprise their roles. 

Directed by J.A. Bayona (The Impossible), the epic action-adventure is written by Jurassic World’s director, Trevorrow, and its co-writer, Derek Connolly. Producers Frank Marshall and Pat Crowley once again partner with Spielberg and Trevorrow in leading the filmmakers for this stunning installment. Belén Atienza joins the team as a producer.

The show is inspired from the famous humorous column 'Duniya Ne Undha Chasma' written by the eminent Gujarati writer Mr. Tarak Mehta. This story evolves around happenings in Gokuldham Co-operative Society and covers topical issues which are socially relevant.The show predominantly - Promoolves around 'Jethalaal' (Dilip Joshi) who is an uneducated Gujarati businessman. Your 'Taarak Mehta' (Sailesh Lodha), is his neighbour. 'Jethalaal' finds a friend and philosopher in 'Taarak Mehta' and often goes to him for advice whenever he is in trouble. Jethalaal's family includes his simpleton wife 'Daya Ben' (Disha Wakani) and a mischievous son 'Tapu' (Bhavya Gandhi). Tapu is a menace and a constant source of trouble to all the members of Gokuldham. They have often warned 'Jethalaal' to reform 'Tapu' or else be prepared to leave the premises. Lost hopes of being heard by his son pushes Jethalaal' to call his father 'Champaklal' (Amit Bhatt) from the village. This was his great idea of leashing some control over the mischievous Tapu. The opposite happens and the grandfather joins hands with the grandson to make life a roller coaster troublesome ride for Jethalaal.

tags: Jurassic World|"Fallen Kingdom"|"Dinosaur"|"T-Rex"|"Chris Pratt"|"Bryce Dallas Howard"|"BD Wong"|"James Cromwell"|"Ted Levine"|"Justice Smith"|"Jeff Goldblum"|"Daniella Pineda"|"J.A. Bayona"|"Colin Trevorrow"|"Steven Spielberg"|"Isla Nublar"|"volcano"|"Jurassic Park"
description:
Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom 
In Theaters June 22, 2018 
Try the Jurassic World effect on your Facebook camera: http://unvrs.al/JWFBCam 

https://www.jurassicworld.com 

It’s been four years since theme park and luxury resort Jurassic World was destroyed by dinosaurs out of containment. Isla Nublar now sits abandoned by humans while the surviving dinosaurs fend for themselves in the jungles. 

When the island’s dormant volcano begins roaring to life, Owen (Chris Pratt) and Claire (Bryce Dallas Howard) mount a campaign to rescue the remaining dinosaurs from this extinction-level event. Owen is driven to find Blue, his lead raptor who’s still missing in the wild, and Claire has grown a respect for these creatures she now makes her mission. Arriving on the unstable island as lava begins raining down, their expedition uncovers a conspiracy that could return our entire planet to a perilous order not seen since prehistoric times.

With all of the wonder, adventure and thrills synonymous with one of the most popular and successful series in cinema history, this all-new motion-picture event sees the return of favorite characters and dinosaurs—along with new breeds more awe-inspiring and terrifying than ever before. Welcome to Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom. 

Stars Pratt and Howard return alongside executive producers Steven Spielberg and Colin Trevorrow for Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom. They are joined by co-stars James Cromwell, Ted Levine, Justice Smith, Geraldine Chaplin, Daniella Pineda, Toby Jones, Rafe Spall and Isabella Sermon, while BD Wong and Jeff Goldblum reprise their roles. 

Directed by J.A. Bayona (The Impossible), the epic action-adventure is written by Jurassic World’s director, Trevorrow, and its co-writer, Derek Connolly. Producers Frank Marshall and Pat Crowley once again partner with Spielberg and Trevorrow in leading the filmmakers for this stunning installment. Belén Atienza joins the team as a producer.

description:
Chal Mohan Ranga Teaser on Telugu Filmnagar. #ChalMohanRanga Latest 2018 Telugu Movie ft. Nithiin / Nitin & and Megha Akash. Produced By Pawan Kalyan & Sudhakar Reddy. Story By Trivikram. Music by Thaman S & directed by Krishna Chaitanya.

#Nithiin #Nitin #Nithin #PawanKalyan #Trivikram #Nithiin25 #MeghaAkash #ChalMohanRanga #ChalMohanRangaTeaser #ChalMohanaRanga #ChalMohanaRangaTeaser #CMR #TeluguFilmnagar

Chal Mohan Ranga Audio will be out exclusively on Mango Music. Stay tuned to #MangoMusic channel for Chal Mohana Ranga Movie Songs: https://www.youtube.com/mangomusic

Chal Mohan Ranga Telugu movie also stars Rao Ramesh, Naresh, Pragathi, Narra Srinu, Srinivasa Reddy, Sanjay Swaroop, And Madhu Among Others.

Tollywood Actor Nithiin Is widely known as Powerstar Pawan Kalyan fan. With Chal Mohan Ranga, the actor is playing the lead role in Pawan Kalyan's first venture as Producer. Trivikram Srinivas, the director of Nithin's Telugu Movie A Aa, had penned the script for #ChalMohanRanga. Nitin's Superhit films include LIE with Megha Akash, Chinnadana Nee Kosam, Gunde Jaari Gallanthayyinde, Ishq, Sye with Baahubali fame SS Rajamouli.

Megha Akash, the female lead in Chal Mohan Ranga made her film debut with Nithin's previous film LIE, directed by Hanu Raghavapudi. Nithin - Megha Akash combination turns as special attraction to the film.

Pawan Kalyan, the Power Star of Tollywood turns as a producer with Pawan Kalyan Creative Works banner - beginning it's journey with Chal Mohan Ranga movie. The actor who is currently busy with his political party Janasena, had recently stormed at box-office with super hit movie Agnyaathavaasi co-featuring Keerthy Suresh and Anu Emmanuel, in Trivikram Srinivas direction. Pawan Kalyan's brother Megastar Chiranjeevi is working for his 151st movie Sye Raa Narasimha Reddy. #PowerstarPawanKalyan nephew Ram Charan is coming up with Rangasthalam movie, while another nephew Varun Tej bagged a hit at box-office with his latest movie Tholi Prema.

Trivikram Srinivas, the director turned writer penned the script for Chal Mohan Ranga movie. Trivikram had many hits like Agnyaathavasi, Attarintiki Daredi and Jalsa with Pawan Kalyan, A Aa with Nithin, Julayi with Allu Arjun and other movies. The director is now teaming up with Jai Lava Kusa star Jr NTR for his new movie.

Thaman S, the music sensation in Tollywood is on hit streak with Varun Tej's Tholi Prema, Anushka Shetty's Bhaagamathie, Sai Dharam Tej's Intelligent and Jawaan, Nagarjuna - Samantha's Raju Gari Gadhi 2 and Sharwanand's Mahanubhavudu. Thaman's music for Chal Mohan Ranga promises to be one of his best works till date.

Krishna Chaitanya, the lyricist turned director made his directorial debut with Nara Rohit's super hit movie Rowdy Fellow. #KrishnaChaitanya had penned lyrics for so many hit songs for stars like Mahesh Babu, Jr NTR, Ram Charan, Nithin, Nani, Ravi Teja, Akkineni Nagarjuna and Siddharth among others.

Sreshth Movies, started by Nithin's father Sudhakar Reddy is a well known production house and distribution company in Tollywood. The company had bankrolled movies like Akhil Akkineni's debut film Akhil, Nithiin's Ishq, Gunde Jaari Gallanthayyinde and Chinnadana Nee Kosam.

Trivikram Srinivas, the director turned writer penned the script for Chal Mohan Ranga movie. Trivikram had many hits like Agnyaathavasi, Attarintiki Daredi and Jalsa with Pawan Kalyan, A Aa with Nithin, Julayi with Allu Arjun and other movies. The director is now teaming up with Jai Lava Kusa star Jr NTR for his new movie.

Thaman S, the music sensation in Tollywood is on hit streak with Varun Tej's Tholi Prema, Anushka Shetty's Bhaagamathie, Sai Dharam Tej's Intelligent and Jawaan, Nagarjuna - Samantha's Raju Gari Gadhi 2 and Sharwanand's Mahanubhavudu. Thaman's music for Chal Mohan Ranga promises to be one of his best works till date.

Krishna Chaitanya, the lyricist turned director made his directorial debut with Nara Rohit's super hit movie Rowdy Fellow. #KrishnaChaitanya had penned lyrics for so many hit songs for stars like Mahesh Babu, Jr NTR, Ram Charan, Nithin, Nani, Ravi Teja, Akkineni Nagarjuna and Siddharth among others.

description:
Fasting Paneer Pakora, Paneer ke Vrat wale Pakode, vrat ka khana, Paneer Ke Pakode Navratri Special, Upvas Paneer Pakoda

Ingredients   
Paneer (पनीर)  - 400 gms 
Samo rice (समा के चावल )  - 1/2 cup (100 gms) ( soaked and grinded ) 
Water Chestnut Flour (सिंघारे का आटा) - 1/4 cup ( 40 gms ) 
Green Coriander (हरा धनिया )  - 2 tbsp ( finely chopped ) 
Green chillies (हरी मिर्च )  - 2 ( finely chopped) 
Black Pepper (काली मिर्च )  - 1/4 tsp 
Sendha Salt (सेंधा नमक )  - 1 tsp ( or to taste) 
Oil (तेल )  - For frying 

How to Make Falahari Paneer Pakora : 

1. Make batter of running consistency for pakora using grinded samo rice, water chesnut flour using water in small portions. If the batter seems dense add a bit of water to it. 
2. In it add black pepper powder, sendha salt, finely chopped green chili, finely chopped green coriander. Mix all ingredients well. Meanwhile Put the oil to heat for frying the pakoras.Turn on flame. 
3. Take paneer cut the paneer pieces in the desired shape, make sure the pieces are joint from below. Meanwhile for stuffing mix,black pepper powder, sendha salt. Mix it. 
4. Fill masala in the paneer pieces, Press the paneer piece and keep aside. Stuff all the paneer pieces with spice mix likewise.Check if oil is suffeciently hot. 
5. Stir the batter once, dip the stuffed paneer pieces in it, and coat it well with batter. Remove the extra batter. Put the pieces in oil to fry. Prepare all the pakoras and fry likewise. 
6. Flip and fry them until golden brown. Take them out from the wok and keep in a plate. Fry all likewise. It takes 4 to 5 minutes to fry the pakoras at once. 

Serving : 
7. Sumptuous Falahari Paneer pakoras are ready.serve it with curd, falahari green coriander chutney or falahari sweet chutney of your choice.

description: Suresh, popularly known as Vava Suresh (Malayalam:വാവ സുരേഷ്) (born 1974), is an Indian wildlife conservationist and a snake expert. He is known for his missions for saving snakes straying into human inhabited areas in Kerala, India. He captured 100 king cobras, he is believed to have captured and rescued more than 50,000 straying snakes. He has been bitten 300 times by venomous snakes and bitten more than 3000 times by all types of snakes. He has been on ventilator thrice and six times in ICU, mainly because he doesn't use any type of safety equipments. He is widely known for his conservation activities like the rescue and release of endangered species of snakes, preservation of collected eggs until hatching periods, and creating awareness among people about snakes and their behavior. He releases his reptile collections into natural habitats at regular intervals of time. His efforts to capture venomous snakes from human populated areas and to educate the people about snakes and their behavior is widely acknowledged.

description: Aam Kheer, Mango Rice Pudding, mango rice kheer recipe, Aamer Payesh, Mambalam Payasam, Ingredients : Full Cream Milk (दूध)  - 1 ltr Ripe Mango (पके आम )  - 1 cup (pulp) Ripe Mango (पके आम ) - 1/2 cup (finely chopped) Rice Grain (छोटे चावल )  - 1/4 cup (soaked) Sugar (चीनी )  - 1/2 cup Green Cardamoms (इलायची )- 1/4 tsp (powder) Cashews (काजू ) - 8 to 10 Almonds (बादाम ) - 8 to 10 How to make Mango Rice Kheer: 1. Take full cream milk,Put it to boil.2. Take cashews and almonnds, thinly chop some and cut some. 3. As the milk boils, stir it, then reduce flame, Add soaked rice. Stir at intervals and cook on low medium flame.4. Once Milk and rice are of same consistency, add the cut cashews and almonds. Stir at intervals and cook for 4 to 5 more minutes.5. When kheer is dense in consistency add sugar to it. Add cardamom powder. Mix well. Cook the Kheer on low flame for 1 to 2 minutes. Turn off flame. 6. Let the Kheer cool, then add mango pulp to it and mix well. Garnish with mango pieces, cashews, almonds. Serving: 7. Yummy Mango Kheer is ready to be served. title: Falcon Heavy Test Flight
tags: [none]
description: When Falcon Heavy lifts off, it will be the most powerful operational rocket in the world by a factor of two. With the ability to lift into orbit nearly 64 metric tons (141,000 lb)---a mass greater than a 737 jetliner loaded with passengers, crew, luggage and fuel--Falcon Heavy can lift more than twice the payload of the next closest operational vehicle, the Delta IV Heavy, at one-third the cost. Falcon Heavy draws upon the proven heritage and reliability of Falcon 9. \n\nIts first stage is composed of three Falcon 9 nine-engine cores whose 27 Merlin engines together generate more than 5 million pounds of thrust at liftoff, equal to approximately eighteen 747 aircraft. Only the Saturn V moon rocket, last flown in 1973, delivered more payload to orbit. Falcon Heavy was designed from the outset to carry humans into space and restores the possibility of flying missions with crew to the Moon or Mars.

Spanish La Liga
Real Madrid vs Girona
7:45pm Sunday 18th March
Santiago Bernabeu   (Att: 59097)

The 50th hat-trick of Cristiano Ronaldo's stellar career inspired Real Madrid to an entertaining 6-3 victory at home to Girona in LaLiga.
Cristiano Ronaldo's remarkable run of form continued with the 50th hat-trick of his career as his four-goal haul inspired Real Madrid to a thrilling 6-3 win over Girona in LaLiga on Sunday.

The Portuguese netted for the eighth game in a row in all competitions, while it was the fourth league outing in succession in which he has found the net at least twice.

A quiet start to 2017-18 saw Ronaldo score just four LaLiga goals before the turn of the year but since late January he has been virtually unstoppable, this stunning display at the Santiago Bernabeu taking his tally to 21 in his past 11 outings across domestic and continental competitions.

His first arrived in the 11th minute, a clinical left-footed finish from Toni Kroos' ball, but Girona pegged the champions back shortly before the half-hour as Cristhian Stuani headed home from a free-kick.

Ronaldo restored Madrid's advantage early in the second period at the end of a fine move and then added an assist for good measure as Lucas Vazquez - who saw a goal wrongly ruled out for offside in the first half - got in on the act.

The matchball was secured soon after the hour as Ronaldo converted a rebound before Stuani bagged his second with another header - his ninth this season via that method, a LaLiga high.

Substitute Gareth Bale joined in the fun four minutes from time and although Madrid conceded their third header of the game to Juanpe, it was fitting that Ronaldo had the last word by rifling in his fourth in stoppage time.

description: Japanese Street Food in Tokyo, Japan is INSANELY delicious! We traveled here to eat, and tried a ton of Japanese Street Food, like Wagyu Beef Steak BBQ, delicious raw Japanese seafood like Oysters, and more!Today, I'm (The Food Ranger, Trevor James) taking you to some local street foods in Tokyo, Japan, starting out with some super delicious Yakitori and horse offal stew.First, we are trying out some Japanese BBQ Yakitori skewers for lunch at a local market, the Ameya Yokocho. Here, you can find all sorts of delicious Japanese street food and seafood! From Sushi to fresh seafood, it's all here!After this, we found a nice local seafood stall, where you can order raw scallops on the spot! They were super juicy and plump!After the amazing raw Japanese oysters on the street, we went for a super unique Unagi entire eel bowl over rice, found at Unatoto Eel Restaurant.After this we went for a nice bowl of beef ramen in Tokyo, it was super rich and smooth!After this, we went for a classic Japanese food, the Wagyu beef BBQ Yakuniku! It was the best beef I've ever eaten! Found at Sumibi Yakiniku Nakahara.Even after eating all of these amazing street foods in Tokyo, there is so many more things to eat! You will definitely have to travel here to try them all!ABOUT THE FOOD RANGER-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------My name is Trevor James and I'm a hungry traveler and Mandarin learner that's currently living in Chengdu, Szechuan, China,  eating up as much delicious .I enjoy tasting and documenting as many dishes as I can and I'm going to make videos for YOU along the way! Over the next few years, I'm going to travel around the world and document as much food as I can for you! I love delicious food! This channel will show you real Chinese food and real local food, not that stuff they serve in the Buzzfeed challenge. tags: [none]
description: Following its first test launch, Falcon Heavy is now the most powerful operational rocket in the world by a factor of two. With the ability to lift into orbit nearly 64 metric tons (141,000 lb)---a mass greater than a 737 jetliner loaded with passengers, crew, luggage and fuel--Falcon Heavy can lift more than twice the payload of the next closest operational vehicle, the Delta IV Heavy, at one-third the cost. Falcon Heavy draws upon the proven heritage and reliability of Falcon 9. \n\nIts first stage is composed of three Falcon 9 nine-engine cores whose 27 Merlin engines together generate more than 5 million pounds of thrust at liftoff, equal to approximately eighteen 747 aircraft. Only the Saturn V moon rocket, last flown in 1973, delivered more payload to orbit. Falcon Heavy was designed from the outset to carry humans into space and restores the possibility of flying missions with crew to the Moon or Mars.

title: [Korea v Italy] | Bronze medal game |Ice hockey | PyeongChang2018 Paralympic Winter Games
tags: Paralympics|"Games"|"PyeongChang"|"2018"|"Winter"|"adaptive"|"sport"|"disability"|"disabled"|"Paraolympics"|"Ice"|"hockey"
description:
Time was winding down in the third period of the PyeongChang 2018 bronze-medal game between South Korea and Italy on Saturday (17 March) with the game still scoreless as only 3:18 remained on the clock.

That is when the magic happened for the host nation.

Star speedy forward Seung-Hwan Jung retrieved the puck from behind the net and whipped it around into the front of the crease, where it tipped off Dong-Shing Jangâs stick and through the goal line for what would stand to be the game-winner after undergoing an official review.

The crowd at the Gangneung Hockey Centre, which included South Koreaâs President Moon Jae-in and First Lady Kim Jung-sook, let out an electrifing standing ovation for the team twice â first after scoring the goal and second after fending off Italyâs last-second shot attempts before the final buzzer sounded.

South Korea, following nearly a decade of building its Para ice hockey programme for these Games, sealed its first-ever Paralympic medal in the sport 11 months after taking bronze at the 2017 World Para Ice Hockey Championships at the same venue.

It was a moment to remember for everyone present, and for everyone watching throughout the country.

âThis was my third time at the Paralympic Games, and I cannot even begin to express how glad I am and all the feelings Iâm having right now,â Jang said. âSeung-Hwan told me after that I had actually put the goal in the net, and I didnât believe him at first. I was just trying to process it and all of this â Iâm numb about the whole thing Iâm so happy.â

The win, in fact, marked the best-ever finish for both teams at the Paralympics. Previously, South Korea finished in sixth place at Vancouver 2010 and seventh at Sochi 2014, while Italy took eighth at Torino 2006, seventh at Vancouver 2010 and sixth at Sochi 2014.

South Korea also successfully flipped the script from the last two times the teams faced each other on the international stage, when the Italians stunned the South Koreans in a thrilling penalty shootout, 3-2, at last yearâs World Championships.

Much of that can be credited to goaltender Jae-Woong Lee who made the start net for South Korea on his 22nd birthday and recorded a magnificent shutout performance with nine saves on the day.

âThis was the best gift for me. I cannot even tell you how glad I am today,â Lee said. âI basically dedicated my whole year to this game â I put everything into it.â

Italian goaltender Gabriele Araudo, who took up the sport after seeing it at the Torino 2006 Games, tallied 13 saves before allowing the puck to go in with just over three minutes remaining in the contest.

It marked the lowest scoring game of the PyeongChang 2018 tournament, yet one of the closest and most memorable finishes in the sportâs history across any event.

Despite the loss, European silver medallists Italy were more than pleased with their performance this week, according to defenceman Andrea Macri, the sportâs liaison to the IPC Athletesâ Council who led his team with 27:29 minutes of ice time in the game.

âItâs a game, and the beautiful part is someone wins and someone loses,â Macri said. âAll of this, though, was a great result for the sport of Para ice hockey, the Paralympic Movement and Italy.â

Meanwhile, the ambassador that he is for the sport, South Koreaâs alternate captain Jung, nicknamed âMessi on Ice,â hopes this means even greater this for the future of South Koreaâs programme.

âIâm very happy about this, and just as importantly that I could share this victory with the sold-out crowd today,â Jung said. âThe audience cheered us on so much today and got behind us, and I hope this inspires more athletes in our country to take up the sport in the future.â

Real Madrid vs Girona
7:45pm Sunday 18th March
Santiago Bernabeu   (Att: 59097)

The 50th hat-trick of Cristiano Ronaldo's stellar career inspired Real Madrid to an entertaining 6-3 victory at home to Girona in LaLiga.
Cristiano Ronaldo's remarkable run of form continued with the 50th hat-trick of his career as his four-goal haul inspired Real Madrid to a thrilling 6-3 win over Girona in LaLiga on Sunday.

The Portuguese netted for the eighth game in a row in all competitions, while it was the fourth league outing in succession in which he has found the net at least twice.

A quiet start to 2017-18 saw Ronaldo score just four LaLiga goals before the turn of the year but since late January he has been virtually unstoppable, this stunning display at the Santiago Bernabeu taking his tally to 21 in his past 11 outings across domestic and continental competitions.

His first arrived in the 11th minute, a clinical left-footed finish from Toni Kroos' ball, but Girona pegged the champions back shortly before the half-hour as Cristhian Stuani headed home from a free-kick.

Ronaldo restored Madrid's advantage early in the second period at the end of a fine move and then added an assist for good measure as Lucas Vazquez - who saw a goal wrongly ruled out for offside in the first half - got in on the act.

The matchball was secured soon after the hour as Ronaldo converted a rebound before Stuani bagged his second with another header - his ninth this season via that method, a LaLiga high.

Substitute Gareth Bale joined in the fun four minutes from time and although Madrid conceded their third header of the game to Juanpe, it was fitting that Ronaldo had the last word by rifling in his fourth in stoppage time.

description:
We have an updated version of this webcast that includes both side booster cameras and additional Starman views here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bCc16uozHVE

When Falcon Heavy lifts off, it will be the most powerful operational rocket in the world by a factor of two. With the ability to lift into orbit nearly 64 metric tons (141,000 lb)---a mass greater than a 737 jetliner loaded with passengers, crew, luggage and fuel--Falcon Heavy can lift more than twice the payload of the next closest operational vehicle, the Delta IV Heavy, at one-third the cost. Falcon Heavy draws upon the proven heritage and reliability of Falcon 9. 

Its first stage is composed of three Falcon 9 nine-engine cores whose 27 Merlin engines together generate more than 5 million pounds of thrust at liftoff, equal to approximately eighteen 747 aircraft. Only the Saturn V moon rocket, last flown in 1973, delivered more payload to orbit. Falcon Heavy was designed from the outset to carry humans into space and restores the possibility of flying missions with crew to the Moon or Mars.

title: Falcon Heavy Test Flight
tags: [none]
description: When Falcon Heavy lifts off, it will be the most powerful operational rocket in the world by a factor of two. With the ability to lift into orbit nearly 64 metric tons (141,000 lb)---a mass greater than a 737 jetliner loaded with passengers, crew, luggage and fuel--Falcon Heavy can lift more than twice the payload of the next closest operational vehicle, the Delta IV Heavy, at one-third the cost. Falcon Heavy draws upon the proven heritage and reliability of Falcon 9. \n\nIts first stage is composed of three Falcon 9 nine-engine cores whose 27 Merlin engines together generate more than 5 million pounds of thrust at liftoff, equal to approximately eighteen 747 aircraft. Only the Saturn V moon rocket, last flown in 1973, delivered more payload to orbit. Falcon Heavy was designed from the outset to carry humans into space and restores the possibility of flying missions with crew to the Moon or Mars.

Coming from a family of cinema legends, he himself became a film star, and then saw dizzying heights and darkest depths: adulation of diehard fans, unending battles with various addictions, brushes with the underworld, prison terms, loss of loved ones, and the haunting speculation that he might or might not be a terrorist.

title: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom - Official Trailer [HD]
tags: Jurassic World|"Fallen Kingdom"|"Jurassic Park"|"T-Rex"|"Dinosaur"|"J.A. Bayona"|"Steven Spielberg"|"Colin Trevorrow"|"Chris Pratt"|"Bryce Dallas Howard"|"BD Wong"|"James Cromwell"|"Ted Levine"|"Justice Smith"|"Geraldine Chaplin"|"Daniella Pineda"|"Toby Jones"|"Jeff Goldblum"|"Rafe Spall"|"Derek Connolly"|"Isla Nublar"|"Raptor"
description:
Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom
In Theaters June 22, 2018 

https://www.jurassicworld.com

It’s been four years since theme park and luxury resort Jurassic World was destroyed by dinosaurs out of containment.  Isla Nublar now sits abandoned by humans while the surviving dinosaurs fend for themselves in the jungles.

When the island’s dormant volcano begins roaring to life, Owen (Chris Pratt) and Claire (Bryce Dallas Howard) mount a campaign to rescue the remaining dinosaurs from this extinction-level event.  Owen is driven to find Blue, his lead raptor who’s still missing in the wild, and Claire has grown a respect for these creatures she now makes her mission.  Arriving on the unstable island as lava begins raining down, their expedition uncovers a conspiracy that could return our entire planet to a perilous order not seen since prehistoric times.

With all of the wonder, adventure and thrills synonymous with one of the most popular and successful series in cinema history, this all-new motion-picture event sees the return of favorite characters and dinosaurs—along with new breeds more awe-inspiring and terrifying than ever before.  Welcome to Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom.  

Stars Pratt and Howard return alongside executive producers Steven Spielberg and Colin Trevorrow for Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom.  They are joined by co-stars James Cromwell, Ted Levine, Justice Smith, Geraldine Chaplin, Daniella Pineda, Toby Jones, Rafe Spall and Isabella Sermon, while BD Wong and Jeff Goldblum reprise their roles.

Directed by J.A. Bayona (The Impossible), the epic action-adventure is written by Jurassic World’s director, Trevorrow, and its co-writer, Derek Connolly.  Producers Frank Marshall and Pat Crowley once again partner with Spielberg and Trevorrow in leading the filmmakers for this stunning installment.  Belén Atienza joins the team as a producer.

tags: [none]
description:
We have an updated version of this webcast that includes both side booster cameras and additional Starman views here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bCc16uozHVE

When Falcon Heavy lifts off, it will be the most powerful operational rocket in the world by a factor of two. With the ability to lift into orbit nearly 64 metric tons (141,000 lb)---a mass greater than a 737 jetliner loaded with passengers, crew, luggage and fuel--Falcon Heavy can lift more than twice the payload of the next closest operational vehicle, the Delta IV Heavy, at one-third the cost. Falcon Heavy draws upon the proven heritage and reliability of Falcon 9. 

Its first stage is composed of three Falcon 9 nine-engine cores whose 27 Merlin engines together generate more than 5 million pounds of thrust at liftoff, equal to approximately eighteen 747 aircraft. Only the Saturn V moon rocket, last flown in 1973, delivered more payload to orbit. Falcon Heavy was designed from the outset to carry humans into space and restores the possibility of flying missions with crew to the Moon or Mars.

description: Following its first test launch, Falcon Heavy is now the most powerful operational rocket in the world by a factor of two. With the ability to lift into orbit nearly 64 metric tons (141,000 lb)---a mass greater than a 737 jetliner loaded with passengers, crew, luggage and fuel--Falcon Heavy can lift more than twice the payload of the next closest operational vehicle, the Delta IV Heavy, at one-third the cost. Falcon Heavy draws upon the proven heritage and reliability of Falcon 9. \n\nIts first stage is composed of three Falcon 9 nine-engine cores whose 27 Merlin engines together generate more than 5 million pounds of thrust at liftoff, equal to approximately eighteen 747 aircraft. Only the Saturn V moon rocket, last flown in 1973, delivered more payload to orbit. Falcon Heavy was designed from the outset to carry humans into space and restores the possibility of flying missions with crew to the Moon or Mars.

In “Incredibles 2,” Helen (voice of Holly Hunter) is called on to lead a campaign to bring Supers back, while Bob (voice of Craig T. Nelson) navigates the day-to-day heroics of “normal” life at home with Violet (voice of Sarah Vowell), Dash (voice of Huck Milner) and baby Jack-Jack—whose super powers are about to be discovered. Their mission is derailed, however, when a new villain emerges with a brilliant and dangerous plot that threatens everything. But the Parrs don’t shy away from a challenge, especially with Frozone (voice of Samuel L. Jackson) by their side. That’s what makes this family so Incredible.
 
Written and directed by Brad Bird (“Iron Giant,” “The Incredibles,” “Ratatouille”) and produced by John Walker (“The Incredibles,” “Tomorrowland”) and Nicole Grindle (“Sanjay’s Super Team” short, “Toy Story 3” associate producer), Disney•Pixar’s “Incredibles 2” busts into theaters on June 15, 2018.
